sections.Aims and Fit of Module: This module delves into the concept and framework of a digital talent ecosystem and how to build one for diversified organisations in the digital world. By engaging in a talent ecosystem, organisations can unlock human power to drive strategic innovation and sustainable growth. To remain adaptable, organisations must address knowledge and skills gaps that impede their strategies. This module details the key components of an effective digital talent ecosystem, offering practical frameworks for its development and long-term sustainability. This module also provides insights into building a talent ecosystem that fosters entrepreneurship and innovation in the digital era. Students will gain essential knowledge and techniques, including digital talent acquisition and selection, engagement and development, and practical application of digital tools, to build an effective digital talent ecosystem to support high-performing, innovative organisations. They will learn how to apply these skills to build a high-performing, innovative organisation by utilising creative talent sources, establishing networks of trusted partners, and developing innovative solutions.
sections.Learning outcomes: A. Demonstrate critical understanding of digital talents ecosystem management. B. Comprehend the representative frameworks or approaches to digital talents ecosystem. C. Employ evolving methods in digital talents ecosystem, and learn how to proactively respond to emerging trends with complexity mindset and sufficient capacity.
sections.Method of teaching and learning: Based on the philosophy of Syntegrative Education, this module’s delivery pattern follows more intensive block teaching, and allows more meaningful contribution from industry partners. This delivery pattern provides space for students to concentrate on completing the problem-based and project-oriented assessments. This module will be delivered through a series of key lectures/seminars. We will discuss the rapidly changing talent pool and examine latest technologies and systems in the field. External experts and industry leaders will be invited as guest speaker to share real world practices and experiences.
